_doc: #412: Buccaneer is playable and its pool generates cards from upgrades/buccaneer.json. The remaining legacy Pirate cards support the unported Gunslinger and skill tests. B4 #416 removed the five ported Brawler attacks' legacy cards. C4 #388 removed the four ported Gunslinger fillers' (Double Shot, Invisible Shot, Recoil Shot, Grenade). Dash is a mobility skill and has no cards. Tier A: canonical skill levels. Tier C: legacy attack learn/rank weights 4/3, Bullet Time and booster weights 2/2, behaviour weight 2 and at most three steps; shared Potential magnitudes apply. Oak Barrel (#194) remains a legacy Brawler skill (learn/rank weights 3/2, max rank 10).
